name: I Heard It Through the Grapevine

podcast.body: This Marvin Gaye cover became The Slits' biggest song on their 1979 album "Cut." Despite writing most of their own material, their distinctive interpretation of this classic track achieved significant recognition within the British punk scene. "And although they wrote most of their own material, their biggest song was this Marvin Gaye Cover."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
